definitions.gloss: late-night bus; overnight bus; night bus
definitions.explanation: A bus that operates during late-night hours, including long-distance overnight buses that travel between cities while passengers sleep.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}バス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to Osaka by night bus.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}バス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Night buses are cheaper than the bullet train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{深夜|しんや}バス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{利用|りよう}していた→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a student, I often used night buses to save money.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧ (late night) and ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ (bus). Refers both to local late-night bus services and to long-distance overnight highway buses (⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧⟦{夜行|やこう}バス→夜行バス：22452_yakoubasu⟧) that are popular as a budget alternative to the ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深夜|しんや}バス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a night bus
- {深夜|しんや}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: night bus reservation
- {深夜|しんや}バス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{移動|いどう}する→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧: to travel by night bus
- {深夜|しんや}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: night bus timetable

CULTURAL NOTE:
Overnight highway buses are a major part of Japan's transportation network, connecting major cities at a fraction of the cost of the ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧. They are especially popular among students and budget travelers. Modern versions offer reclining seats, privacy curtains, and individual entertainment systems.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}バス→夜行バス：22452_yakoubasu⟧: overnight bus — emphasizes traveling through the night; essentially synonymous
- ⟦{高速|こうそく}バス→高速バス：20782_kousokubasu⟧: highway bus — long-distance bus, may run day or night
- ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧: last train — the final train of the day, often the reason people take a night bus instead
